map.→ 打开选址（评估/竞争/目标）模型工具: -> Open the site selection (assessment/competition/goal) model tool
map.各项权重是怎么定的？: How are the weights for each item set?
map.填写「500m内竞争店数」。: Fill in "number of competing stores within 500m".
map.填写「周边常住人口」。: Fill in "resident population in the surrounding area".
map.对多个候选铺位分别评估，按总分排序选出优先洽谈的对象。: Evaluate several candidate shop units separately, rank them by total score, and pick the one to negotiate first.
map.已开业门店做复盘时回填参数，验证当年选址判断是否与经营表现一致。: When reviewing a store that has already opened, fill the parameters back in to check whether the original site selection judgement matches actual trading performance.
map.开便利店或门店前，按人流、竞争、人口、租金、面积与可见性六项打分，得到综合选址得: Before opening a convenience store or shop, score footflow, competition, population, rent, area and visibility to get an overall site selection score and recommendations.
map.按日均人流量、竞争店数、常住人口、租金、面积与可见性评分综合测算，输出加权得分与: Computes a combined figure from average daily footfall, number of competing stores, resident population, rent, area and visibility score, and outputs a weighted score with site selection advice to support store siting and trade-area assessment.
map.是。竞争对手每增加 1 家该项扣约 15 分，最低 0 分；但适度竞争也可能代表: Yes. Each additional competitor deducts about 15 points on that item, with a floor of 0; but moderate competition can also signal a mature trade area, so it should be read together with footfall and population.
map.竞争店数越多得分越低？: Does a higher number of competing stores lower the score?
map.综合 ≥75 为优秀（强烈推荐）、60–74 良好、45–59 一般需谨慎、<4: An overall score of 75 or above is excellent (strongly recommended), 60-74 good, 45-59 average and needs caution, and below 45 not recommended; the bands are only a reference for side-by-side comparison.
map.页面内置经验权重：人流 30%、竞争 20%、人口 20%、租金 15%、可见性: The page ships with empirical weights: footfall 30%, competition 20%, population 20%, rent 15%, visibility 15%. For a different business type you can judge what it emphasises from this, and whether to adjust is up to your own operating experience.
map.高租金被其他维度抵消: High rent offset by other dimensions
map.：A 铺：人流 8000、竞争 2 家、人口 3 万、租金 120 元/m²、可: : Unit A: footfall 8000, 2 competitors, population 30,000, rent 120 CNY/m2, visibility 8 -> overall about 82 (excellent). Unit B: footfall 3000, 5 competitors, population 10,000, rent 200 CNY/m2, visibility 5 -> about 48 (average). With limited resources, negotiate Unit A first.
map.：某铺租金 260 元/m²（得分较低），但人流、人口与可见性均接近满分，综合仍: : a unit with rent of 260 CNY/m2 scores low on rent, but footfall, population and visibility are all near full marks, so the overall score still reaches 70. This shows that high rent can be partly offset by strong footfall and should not be rejected on rent alone.
